title: bahw-world-heavyweight
label: Rick "The Reaper" Erickson

won.source: Already the reigning champion at the held record's earliest surviving card, Hardcore Haven (24 February 1997); no won-date survives in the held record.

how: Retained against James Havok at Hardcore Haven (24 Feb 1997) and against El Perfecto at Saturday Nite (1 Mar 1997, pinfall, 23:45); still billed as champion into a 7 May 1997 title defense against "The Shroud" Anthony Alred, the outcome of which this collection does not hold.

title: bahw-united-states
label: Chimera

won.source: BAHW Hardcore Haven (24 February 1997): Chimera defeated the reigning champion, "Paralizer" Patrick Bordeau, for the United States Championship in 14:24.

how: Pinfall over Patrick "Paralizer" Bordeau at Hardcore Haven.

title: bahw-television
label: "The Perfectionist" Nik Nyce

won.source: BAHW Hardcore Haven (24 February 1997): Nik Nyce won a tournament final, one hour and five minutes, to become the first BAHW Television Champion in the held record.

how: Tournament final, 1:05:00. Retained one week later (Saturday Nite, 1 Mar 1997) against The Nordic Nightmare.

title: bahw-cruiserweight
label: El Jaguar

won.source: BAHW Hardcore Haven (24 February 1997): El Jaguar defeated The Ring Assassin in 8:43 for the Cruiserweight Championship.

how: Pinfall over The Ring Assassin at Hardcore Haven. A new Cruiserweight tournament is referenced by 7 May 1997 (Wednesday WARzone); the change between El Jaguar's win and that tournament is not receipted in this collection's own holdings.
